verified_notes: Corrected: polytechnic admission after Class 10 is via DTE Karnataka merit/counselling, NOT DCET (DCET = lateral entry to BTech).
Refined govt PU fees (~₹1,500–6,500/yr) and govt polytechnic fees (~₹6,000–13,000/yr, branch-dependent).
Sep 2026 verification pass (scholarships + eligibility): corroborated across multiple sources —

• Polytechnic eligibility: min 35% SSLC + compulsory Maths & Science, merit-based (no entrance) via DTE Karnataka; admissions portal is dtetech.karnataka.gov.in (dtek… is exams/results). Removed an unverified 'min age 15'.
• ITI eligibility: min 35% Class 10 for engineering trades; min age ~14; merit-based.
• PM YASASVI pre-matric: ₹4,000/yr, income < ₹2.5 lakh, OBC/EBC/DNT.
• NMMS: ₹12,000/yr, income ≤ ₹3.5 lakh — but govt/aided/local-body school ONLY (excludes private/KV/NVS), so most CBSE private-school students are ineligible; flag honestly.
• Vidyadhan (Karnataka): ₹10,000/yr, 90% Class-10 cutoff (75% for disability), income < ₹2 lakh.
• AICTE Pragati/Saksham: ₹50,000/yr, income ≤ ₹8 lakh, AICTE-approved diploma, girls/differently-abled only.
• SSP Karnataka canonical portal corrected to ssp.karnataka.gov.in.

Added specialized_pathways[] expansion tier (9 entries: integrated PU+coaching, NSDC/PMKVY skill dev, creative/design, sports academy, agriculture/allied, paramedical/allied health, aviation/maritime, entrepreneurship, alternative education NIOS/IB-IGCSE) — ALL unverified (needs_verification=true), LLM-sourced, pending primary confirmation. Aviation/maritime carries a scam-risk + post-12-entry caution; entrepreneurship framed as an enrichment add-on; IB/IGCSE flagged out-of-Phase-1-scope.

STILL NEEDS OFFICIAL/PRIMARY CONFIRMATION: current-year per-college private & coaching fees, exhaustive college lists, NIOS fee specifics, all specialized_pathways[] entries, and each scholarship's live cycle/deadline. Corroboration above is from multiple secondary aggregators, not primary portals — before go-live, confirm against DTE Karnataka (dtetech.karnataka.gov.in), PUE (pue.karnataka.gov.in), KEA (cetonline.karnataka.gov.in), scholarships.gov.in, ssp.karnataka.gov.in and vidyadhan.org.
verification.note: INTERNAL audit trail only — not shown to users. Retained so a data owner keeps the Sep-2026 verification findings.

usage_notes: options[] powers Mode A (Explore): show the full set (the 7 core options), never eliminate one, always surface at least one the student had not considered.

specialized_pathways[] is the EXPANSION TIER: do NOT show in the primary option wall. Surface these under a distinct 'Paths you might not have considered' section so Explore leads with the core 7 and keeps decision fatigue low. As with all facts in this MVP, treat these as provisional under the blanket disclaimer. This is where the 'surface ≥1 unconsidered option' principle lives without overwhelming the core decision.
pathways[] powers Mode B (Aspire/Plan, thin preview): next-horizon steps only, honest cost + real routes, adjacent destinations, and a 'what if this changes' fallback.
AI weighting sits ON TOP of this data as a light, disclaimered overlay — it must not invent options, scholarships, or links beyond what is listed here.
sources: NOTE: aggregator sources (buddy4study, collegedekho, schemesinindia) are secondary corroboration, not primary portals.

options.name: Pre-University (PU) — Science
options.summary: Two-year pre-degree, Science stream. The widest-keeping option: engineering, medicine, research, and still allows a later pivot to commerce or arts at degree level.
options.keeps_open: Broadest downstream range of the academic streams.

eligibility.text: Passed CBSE Class 10. College-specific cutoffs; PCM typically expects comfort with Maths, PCB with Biology.

options.honest_notes: Cost variance is huge; coaching-integrated PU can be very expensive. Science does not 'lock you in' — but a strong aversion to Maths/Science is a real signal to weigh, not ignore.

human_touchpoint.idea: Short story from a current PU Science student or recent alum.

options.name: Pre-University (PU) — Commerce
combinations: Commerce without Maths (with Statistics/Economics/Business Studies etc.)
options.summary: Two-year pre-degree, Commerce stream. Route to finance, accountancy, business, economics and law.
options.keeps_open: Strong for business/finance; 'with Maths' keeps more analytics/economics doors open.

eligibility.text: Passed CBSE Class 10. 'With Maths' combinations may expect reasonable Maths marks.

options.honest_notes: Often wrongly seen as 'lesser' than Science; it is a strong, distinct path. Only ~14% choose it nationally (see PRD S4) — scarcity is not weakness.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a CA aspirant or B.Com student.

options.name: Pre-University (PU) — Humanities / Arts
combinations: History, Economics, Political Science, Sociology, Psychology, Languages, Fine Arts (varies by college)
options.summary: Two-year pre-degree, Humanities stream. Route to law, civil services, design, media, psychology, social sciences and the arts.
options.keeps_open: Best fit for language/creative/social-science strengths; underrated for career breadth.

eligibility.text: Passed CBSE Class 10. Generally the most open on marks; subject choice varies by college.

options.honest_notes: This is the option most often denied to a creative/maths-averse student under family pressure (see PRD S6 voice-of-user). Present it with genuine career routes, not as a fallback.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a designer, lawyer, or civil-services aspirant who took Humanities.

options.name: Polytechnic Diploma
options.summary: Three-year hands-on technical diploma via Karnataka's Department of Technical Education. Employable on completion, and offers lateral entry directly into the 2nd year of BTech.
leads_to: Lateral entry to BTech (saves one year)
options.keeps_open: Strong practical + BTech bridge; good for hands-on learners who want earlier employability.

eligibility.text: Passed SSLC/Class 10 with min 35% marks and Maths & Science as compulsory subjects. First-year admission is merit-based (SSLC marks) via DTE Karnataka online counselling — NO entrance exam, and NOT DCET (DCET is the later lateral-entry-to-BTech test for diploma holders). Admissions portal: dtetech.karnataka.gov.in.

where_in_bangalore.note: Allotted via DTE Karnataka merit/counselling. College list is illustrative, not exhaustive — confirm current participating colleges on dtetech.karnataka.gov.in.

approx_cost_inr.sc_st: often reduced to nil via post-matric scholarship

entrance_exams_it_feeds: Admission via DTE Karnataka merit/counselling (after Class 10)
Later: DCET for lateral entry to BTech
options.honest_notes: Often invisible to CBSE families who default to PU. A genuinely strong, low-cost, employable route — worth surfacing as an expansion option.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a diploma holder who did lateral entry to BTech.

options.name: ITI (Industrial Training Institute)
options.summary: Trade-focused vocational training, roughly 6 months to 2 years. Fastest route to a skilled job; strong for government/PSU recruitment (Railways, electricity boards).
options.keeps_open: Fastest to earning; can be combined with later diploma/further study.

eligibility.text: Passed Class 10 with min 35% marks for engineering trades (Electrician, Fitter, etc.); some non-engineering/lower trades accept Class 8 pass. Minimum age ~14, no upper age limit. Merit-based admission (state counselling); rural Class 1-10 schooling can earn grace marks.

options.honest_notes: Best when a student needs to start earning within 1-2 years (an economic-necessity path — pair honestly with routes, per PRD S6). Not 'lesser' — high demand for Electrician/Fitter.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from an ITI Electrician now employed / in a PSU.

options.name: NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling)
combinations: Flexible subject choice; open/distance mode for 10+2
options.summary: Open-schooling route for 10+2 with flexible subjects and pace. Accepted for polytechnic, ITI, vocational admissions and government jobs.
options.keeps_open: Flexibility for students who need a non-standard pace or path; a real safety net, not a last resort.

eligibility.text: Open eligibility; commonly used after Class 10 for flexible 10+2. Check subject and exam rules on NIOS portal.

options.honest_notes: Useful for students under stress or with atypical circumstances; frame supportively, never as failure.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a student who used NIOS to change direction successfully.

options.name: Vocational / Skill Courses
options.summary: Skill-oriented courses across digital, healthcare and creative fields — some available alongside or instead of a traditional stream.
options.keeps_open: Good for a student with a clear practical/creative interest; verify recognition of the specific course.

eligibility.text: Varies by course/provider; many accept Class 10 pass.

where_in_bangalore.note: Verify provider recognition (this is where scams cluster).

entrance_exams_it_feeds: Mostly direct admission; verify credential recognition
options.honest_notes: Recognition varies wildly — flag unrecognised/for-profit courses honestly. Do not list a course whose credential value cannot be verified.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from someone employed via a recognised vocational course.

next_horizon_steps: After Class 10: choose PU Science with Biology (PCB or PCMB).
Across Class 11-12: build toward NEET (national medical entrance).
Stay aware: NEET is highly competitive — plan realistically and know the alternatives below.
pathways.honest_cost_effort: MBBS is ~5.5 years after Class 12, very competitive, and expensive without a government seat. Scholarships/aid exist — see routes.
pathways.what_if_it_changes: PCB/PCMB still keeps pharmacy, allied health, biosciences and research open — not a dead end.

next_horizon_steps: After Class 10: choose PU Science with Maths (PCM or PCMB).
Across Class 11-12: build toward JEE (national) and/or KCET/COMEDK (Karnataka).
Alternative entry: a Polytechnic diploma also reaches BTech via lateral entry.
pathways.honest_cost_effort: BE/BTech is 4 years (3 via diploma lateral entry). Cost varies by college; government/aided seats and scholarships lower it.
pathways.what_if_it_changes: PCM keeps most science and analytics paths open; a diploma is a cheaper, employable fallback that still reaches BTech.

pathways.ambition: Work in finance / become a Chartered Accountant
next_horizon_steps: After Class 10: choose PU Commerce (with Maths keeps more open).
Across Class 11-12: you can begin CA Foundation preparation after Class 12.
Explore B.Com/BBA as parallel or alternative degree routes.
pathways.honest_cost_effort: CA is a multi-stage, self-study-heavy qualification; low course fee but demanding and long. B.Com/BBA are 3-year degrees.
real_routes_through_cost: CA has relatively low official fees
pathways.what_if_it_changes: Commerce keeps finance, business, economics and law (via CLAT) open.

pathways.ambition: Work in design / art / a creative field
next_horizon_steps: After Class 10: Humanities/Arts fits best, but design is reachable from any stream.
Across Class 11-12: build a portfolio; explore design entrances (NID/NIFT/UCEED-adjacent).
Consider vocational creative courses (animation, graphic/fashion design) as complements.
pathways.honest_cost_effort: Design degrees vary in cost; portfolio and entrance prep matter more than stream. Creative careers reward demonstrated work.
pathways.what_if_it_changes: A creative direction is buildable from multiple streams — this is the path most wrongly closed off by pressure (see PRD S6).

pathways.ambition: Start earning as soon as possible with a skill
next_horizon_steps: After Class 10: consider ITI (fastest) or a Polytechnic diploma (employable + BTech bridge).
Choose a high-demand trade (e.g. Electrician, Fitter) or diploma branch.
Look at apprenticeships and government/PSU recruitment routes.
pathways.honest_cost_effort: ITI is low-cost and 6 months to 2 years; diploma is 3 years but opens BTech. Both are far cheaper than the degree-first route.
pathways.what_if_it_changes: Skilled trades and diplomas still allow further study later — earning early does not close the door to a degree.

specialized_pathways.name: Integrated PU + Coaching (NEET / JEE / CA / CLAT)
specialized_pathways.summary: A PU college that bundles the two-year PU syllabus with intensive entrance-exam coaching (medical, engineering, CA or law) under one roof. Common in Bengaluru and Mysuru.
leads_to: Same destinations as the underlying PU stream (Science/Commerce), with structured entrance prep built in
specialized_pathways.frame: Not a separate stream — it is a higher-cost, higher-intensity WAY OF DOING PU. Choose the stream first; treat integrated coaching as an add-on for a student who is genuinely exam-focused and can handle the pressure.

eligibility.text: Passed Class 10; college-specific merit/entrance cutoffs, often stricter than plain PU.

where_in_bangalore.note: Illustrative, not exhaustive; recognition and quality vary widely.

approx_cost_inr.note: Substantially higher than plain PU — often ₹80,000 to ₹3,50,000/yr (residential higher).

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: High cost and high pressure. Good for a self-motivated exam aspirant; a poor fit for an unsure student — the intensity can worsen fatigue, not reduce it. Verify the college's actual results before trusting marketing claims.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a student who did integrated PU — what the pressure was really like.

specialized_pathways.name: Skill Development Programs (NSDC / PMKVY)
specialized_pathways.summary: Short-term, national-mission-aligned skill courses — AI/data, robotics, digital marketing, cybersecurity, hospitality and more — via NSDC / PMKVY sector skill councils.
leads_to: A skill stacked on top of a mainstream stream
specialized_pathways.frame: Usually a COMPLEMENT to a mainstream path, not a replacement for one — many are short (weeks to months). Strong for a student with a clear practical interest who wants an employable skill early.

eligibility.text: Varies by course; many accept Class 10 pass. Prefer PMKVY / NSDC-recognised sector skill council courses.

where_in_bangalore.note: Verify the centre is genuinely PMKVY/NSDC-affiliated — this space has many unrecognised for-profit imitators.

approx_cost_inr.note: Many PMKVY courses are free/subsidised; private 'skill' courses vary widely.

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: Credential recognition varies wildly (see the 'vocational' core option) — flag unrecognised/for-profit courses honestly. Best paired with, not instead of, a base qualification.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from someone who got a job via a PMKVY/NSDC course.

specialized_pathways.name: Creative & Design Schools (Early Entry)
specialized_pathways.summary: Early-entry programmes in fashion design, animation, game design, fine arts, or performing arts (music, theatre, dance) — some foundation/diploma courses accept students after Class 10.
specialized_pathways.frame: For a student with a genuine, demonstrated creative interest. Design is also reachable from Humanities or any stream — this is the specialised, earlier-start route, not the only door.

eligibility.text: Varies by institute; many foundation courses accept Class 10 pass, some require a portfolio or aptitude test.

where_in_bangalore.note: Verify credential recognition and placement — this space has many unaccredited private institutes.

approx_cost_inr.note: Highly variable; private design/animation courses can be expensive.

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: Recognition varies widely; do not list a course whose credential value cannot be verified. Portfolio and demonstrated work matter more than the stream — see the 'become a designer/artist' Mode-B pathway.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a working designer/animator who started early.

specialized_pathways.name: Sports Academies (Academics + Training)
specialized_pathways.summary: For students serious about professional sport (cricket, hockey, volleyball, athletics and others). Some PU colleges integrate academics with structured sports training.
leads_to: Careers in coaching, physiotherapy, sports science
specialized_pathways.frame: Pursue ONLY with an academic backup running in parallel — professional sport is high-variance. Prefer academies/PU colleges that keep the student's 10+2 on track.

eligibility.text: Trials/selection by the academy; combine with a PU college that supports a sports track.

where_in_bangalore.note: Illustrative; verify the academy's track record and that academics are genuinely supported.

approx_cost_inr.note: Varies from subsidised (govt/SAI) to expensive private academies.

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: Frame honestly: the odds of full professional success are low, so protect the academic fallback. Sports science / physiotherapy / coaching are real adjacent careers if playing does not work out.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from an athlete who balanced academics and a sports academy.

specialized_pathways.name: Agriculture & Allied Sciences (Diplomas)
specialized_pathways.summary: Specialised diplomas in agriculture, horticulture, veterinary science, sericulture or fisheries — particularly relevant across Karnataka's agrarian districts.
leads_to: Further study (B.Sc Agriculture and allied degrees)
specialized_pathways.frame: A genuinely underrated, low-visibility route for a student interested in agriculture, animals or the outdoors — especially with a rural/land background.

eligibility.text: Passed Class 10; specific diplomas offered via Karnataka's agricultural/horticultural universities and polytechnics — cutoffs and subject requirements vary.

examples: University of Agricultural Sciences, Bengaluru (GKVK) and affiliated diploma programmes
where_in_bangalore.note: Verify current diploma offerings and admission route with the relevant Karnataka agricultural university.

approx_cost_inr.note: Government/university diplomas typically low-cost; verify current fees.

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: Real demand in agri-tech, food processing and allied services; not just 'farming'. Confirm the specific diploma's recognition and progression to a degree.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from an agriculture diploma holder now in agri-tech or extension work.

specialized_pathways.name: Paramedical & Allied Health Diplomas
specialized_pathways.summary: Shorter healthcare-focused diplomas — medical lab technology (DMLT), radiology/imaging, physiotherapy assistant, nursing assistant, and similar — leading into allied-health careers.
specialized_pathways.frame: A real, employable healthcare route that does NOT require the NEET/MBBS marathon — strong for a student drawn to health/care work who wants earlier employability.

eligibility.text: Passed Class 10 (some diplomas require 10+2 with Science — verify per course); offered by recognised paramedical institutes/boards.

examples: Recognised paramedical institutes / hospital-affiliated training schools in Bengaluru
where_in_bangalore.note: This space has many unrecognised private institutes — verify the course is affiliated to a recognised paramedical board/university before listing.

approx_cost_inr.note: Varies; government/hospital-affiliated programmes cheaper than private institutes.

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: Recognition is the critical check here (scam-prone sector). Confirm the awarding board and whether the credential is accepted by employers before showing it to a student.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a lab technician or physiotherapy assistant now employed.

specialized_pathways.name: Aviation & Maritime Training
specialized_pathways.summary: Careers in aviation (pilot, cabin crew) and the merchant navy. Most formal entry is after 10+2 with Science; a few foundation/diploma courses begin after Class 10.
specialized_pathways.frame: CAUTION: the genuine professional routes (commercial pilot, merchant navy officer) almost always need 10+2 with Physics/Maths — not an after-10th shortcut. After-10th 'aviation/maritime foundation' diplomas exist but are often expensive and this sector has many misleading, scam-prone academies.

eligibility.text: Professional routes need 10+2 with Physics & Maths and medical fitness; after-10th foundation courses vary. Verify against DGCA (aviation) / DG Shipping (maritime) recognition.

specialized_pathways.duration: Varies; professional licensing is post-12 and multi-year

where_in_bangalore.note: Only list institutes with verifiable DGCA or DG Shipping recognition — this is a high-scam sector.

approx_cost_inr.note: Pilot training is very expensive (₹40 lakh+); flag cost honestly.

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: Present this cautiously and truthfully: for most Class 10 students the real preparation is 10+2 Science, not an early diploma. Never surface an unrecognised academy. High cost + high scam risk = show with the strongest disclaimers.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a pilot or merchant-navy officer on the real (post-12) pathway and costs.

specialized_pathways.name: Entrepreneurship & Startup Programs
specialized_pathways.summary: Youth entrepreneurship and incubator programmes — Bengaluru's startup ecosystem runs student-focused ventures, workshops and early incubation.
leads_to: A head start on building something while studying
specialized_pathways.frame: An ENRICHMENT ADD-ON, not a stream you choose instead of PU/diploma/ITI. Pursue it ALONGSIDE a base academic path — a student still needs a foundational qualification.

eligibility.text: Open programmes; typically no formal cutoff. Pursue in parallel with a mainstream stream.

where_in_bangalore.note: Verify the programme is reputable and does not charge large fees for vague promises.

approx_cost_inr.note: Many youth programmes are low-cost/free; beware expensive 'young-founder' courses.

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: Framing matters: this is a supplement, never a substitute for a qualification. Great for a self-driven student; do not let it crowd out a base path.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a young founder who built something while still in school/college.

specialized_pathways.name: Alternative Education Routes (NIOS / IB / IGCSE)
specialized_pathways.summary: Non-standard schooling for 10+2: NIOS (flexible open schooling) or international curricula (IB, IGCSE) for families seeking flexibility or global exposure.
specialized_pathways.frame: NIOS is a fully-covered core option (see the 'nios' record) for students needing a flexible pace. IB/IGCSE is a BOARD SWITCH — it sits OUTSIDE Marg's Phase-1 CBSE scope, so it is informational only here (not a Class X→XI stream choice within CBSE), and typically a higher-cost, family-driven decision.

eligibility.text: NIOS: open eligibility after Class 10. IB/IGCSE: admission to an international school; verify recognition for Indian college admission.

where_in_bangalore.note: IB/IGCSE is included for awareness only; it is out of Phase-1 scope.

approx_cost_inr.note: NIOS low-to-moderate; IB/IGCSE international schools are substantially more expensive.

specialized_pathways.honest_notes: Frame NIOS supportively (never as failure). Treat IB/IGCSE as out-of-scope context, not a recommended action — Phase 1 is CBSE, Class X→XI.

human_touchpoint.idea: Story from a student who used NIOS or switched to an international curriculum.

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI (pre-matric, Class 9-10)
scholarships.who: OBC / EBC / DNT; family income under ₹2.5 lakh/year

scholarships.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
scholarships.who: Class 9-12; means + merit. Family income ≤ ₹3.5 lakh/year; ≥55% in Class 7 to sit the Class-8 selection test (relaxation for SC/ST). ONLY government / government-aided / local-body school students — NOT private, KV, NVS or Sainik school students.

scholarships.name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP)
scholarships.who: SC/ST/OBC/minority students in Karnataka; post-matric (after Class 10) among others

scholarships.name: Vidyadhan (Sarojini Damodaran Foundation)
scholarships.who: Karnataka Class 10 pass with ≥90% (≥75% for students with disability); family income < ₹2 lakh/year
scholarships.amount: Up to ₹10,000 per year; covers 2 years of PU, extendable to UG on continued performance

scholarships.name: AICTE Scholarships — Pragati (girls) / Saksham (differently-abled)
scholarships.who: Girls (Pragati) or differently-abled (Saksham) students in 1st/2nd-year (lateral) diploma at an AICTE-approved institute via centralised admission; family income ≤ ₹8 lakh/year; up to two girls per family (Pragati)
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000 per year (lump sum for fees/books/equipment), via DBT
